# Building pay-off: 300 games per bot, seeds 1 to 300

Variant: {}. "Touching nature" (k) counts the 4 squares N, E, S, W that are nature (including river and sea).

Theory assumes each touching nature square supplies the map's average habitat at light use (B 0.8). Land: POL 1.23, GRN 1.69, WAT 1.20. Sea (for harbour, fleet and wind farm): POL 0.00, GRN 0.80, WAT 0.74. Received is capped at 6. Theory ignores waste and pollution, and gives a business park its full +3 for homes. Net = income x happiness multiplier - upkeep.

## Bots

| Bot | Rule | Mean H | Tile-turns | Upkeep as % of income | Event damage as % of income | Tiles at risk hit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| random | Picks pass, build or restore at random, then a random legal choice and square. | 7.3 | 43447 | 30% | 7% | 1326/2528 (52%) |
| greedy | Takes the build or restoration with the best gain in this turn's GDP per pound spent; passes if nothing gains. | 7.3 | 97653 | 26% | 7% | 2867/5224 (55%) |
| nature | Never builds. Every turn it makes the restoration that would add most GDP once the habitat has grown, then most happiness, then most biodiversity. | 9.7 | 14400 | 0% | 1% | 74/896 (8%) |
| balanced | Builds like greedy, but only off ancient habitat and where the new tile keeps at least two nature squares touching it; otherwise restores like the nature bot. | 7.2 | 104400 | 28% | 8% | 3299/5674 (58%) |
